content: The Vuelta a Castilla y León is a multi-stage professional cycling race that takes place in the Castile and León region of Spain. In 2018, the race was held from April 17-21. Riders compete in a series of stages over several days, with the overall winner being the rider who completes the entire course in the fastest total time. Beyond these basic facts about the race being held in 2018 in Spain, I do not have enough confidence in specific details about the 2018 edition to include them without caveats.
